structural_change: r10n2 (KH-NATIVE3 10-17, native audit lanes/NATIVE-2.md claude/native-2-1017 3fd032e8e): +1 configuration-chain stage: fwd_data_q/fwd_addr_q (anchored at the out pins) now take D from the in-face pin flops data_q/addr_q, so each in_data pin drives ONE capture at the in face and the ~150 um in->out traverse is an internal reg->reg leg (r10n: capture 236.1 on 93 in_data pins). Chain hop 1 -> 2 edges; the head (ot_hgi_sfu_programme_store_r10) doubles the chain part of each strobe depth (P0/P3 1, P1/P4 3, P2/P5 5, P6 0, P7 2, IO0 0, IO1 2, IO2 4). Datapath D=5 / status 3 unchanged; host contract (start >= 4 idle edges after the last write) unchanged, 0 slack at IO2. Same outline/pins/macros. Prior: r10n (HBM-NATIVE 10-17): out_data/out_addr driven by dedicated chain-forward export flops instead of the macro-feeding data_q/addr_q (native launch 276.8 -> anchored at the out pins); same outline/pins/macros, 0 cycles. Base: r10 (SFU-PS-FUND 10-17, design decision lanes/SFU-PS-FUND.md): ONE stripe per leaf, 11 identical leaves (replaces r9 leaf2/leaf3 and every stacked-SRAM store). Root cause of r7c4..r9d: 1024x256 macros carry ~416 pins on each 70 um short edge, so stacks put the register mass, the pins and the clock on one face and the far edge needs sinks reached round the stack (insertion 408-617, spread 131-261, M4 overflow under the M5 cap). r10 uses four narrow 512x256 macros as two mirrored pairs (MY | spine | R0): every A edge (read data, address, clock, low write data) faces ONE centre spine that holds the read path; B edges (high write data + ties) face outer bands with no clock sinks; inputs + config chain-out on the N face (N band pin flops), outputs on the S face (S band relay + gated output registers), clk at the S-face spine foot (outputs launch early, inputs capture late). Outline 285.12 x 194.4 (1.47:1), ~1.7k sinks, cycles identical to r7c (lockstep).
